prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Baytown. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me, in your own words, what happened when the collision occurred.

A: I was backing out of a parking space at the shopping center. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me, but as I started to reverse, another vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear driver's side of my car.

Q: How fast were you moving at the time of impact?

A: I'd say I was going very slowly, maybe walking speed. I had just put the car in reverse.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I didn't see it until it hit me. I think it was coming down the aisle fairly quickly.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My neck snapped back and forward, and I've had stiffness and pain since then. I went to urgent care that same afternoon and they told me I had whiplash.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: Yes, I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week, and my doctor has me on muscle relaxers and some over-the-counter pain medication. Turning my head to the left is still painful, and I've had headaches most days.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a few days right after the accident. I'm back at work now, but I have trouble sitting at my desk for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to make sure my treatment costs get covered. I've been doing everything my doctors have asked.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
